instances.h: When polypropylene is the wrong choice

block.h: When polypropylene is the wrong choice
block.intro: Our package is polypropylene (PP) with polyvinyl chloride (PVC) pretreatment. If your URS needs any row below, our package does not fit as written. We will tell you early.
rows: Water for Injection (WFI), pure steam or a sterile-product loop
Outside this package's scope.
A WFI or stainless steel system supplier
A loop held hot, routine 80 °C sanitization at loop pressure, or steam sterilization
Natural PP is rated 0 to 80 °C, and its pressure rating falls as it heats.
A polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) or stainless loop [whether we quote PVDF]
A chlorine or hypochlorite sanitization you cannot change
Polypropylene is not recommended for chlorinated service.
Another chemical method, if your procedures allow it
A corporate or client standard that names 316L stainless steel
A policy, not a technical question. A deviation needs your quality unit's approval.
A stainless steel system supplier
An extension of a hot-sanitized stainless system
The two parts could not share one sanitization regime.
The existing material
Very small or occasional demand
A generation skid and a loop would be oversized. Our range: [standard platforms and capacity ranges].
Service deionization (exchange tanks) or a laboratory polisher
Equipment outdoors, in an unheated room, or pipe in return-air plenums
Unpigmented PP is sensitive to sunlight, and PP is combustible. Some components need a heated room.
A heated indoor plant room, on a route your code accepts

instances.h: Is a packaged system right for your site?

block.h: Is a packaged system right for your site?
block.intro: One wrong-choice line that describes you is enough to rule this package out. No Water for Injection, pure steam or stainless steel systems.
rows: Wrong choice if your products are injected, or need Water for Injection (WFI)
Fits if your products are non-sterile: tablets, capsules, liquids, creams, or devices rinsed with Purified Water
Wrong choice if every product needs only potable water under your specification
Fits if your specification, a monograph or a drug rule asks for Purified Water
Wrong choice if your water loop must be held hot, or sanitized with steam
Fits if an ambient loop, at room temperature, suits your products
Wrong choice if your company standard names stainless steel for water piping
Fits if your specification allows a polypropylene loop, or has no material rule yet

instances.h: Comparing quotes on the same lines

block.h: Comparing quotes on the same lines
block.intro: Quotes differ most in what they leave out. Level every quote on these lines before you compare prices.
rows: Pretreatment
Sized on your water analysis, or on an assumed feed?
Storage and loop
Tank volume, loop length and every point of use counted?
Instruments and controls
Which readings are recorded, and is the code delivered unlocked?
Documents
Which documents, and who writes and signs each?
FAT
Run on water, to a protocol you approve first?
IQ and OQ
Included, a priced option, or left to you?
Warranty start
Counted from shipment, or from acceptance on your site?
Running cost
Per year, at your water and use, with the assumptions written?
